overall: Claude reviewed a10faf3..0444a0f read-only, reproduced the 57-test focused suite, and directly rechecked the implemented failure routing, input-before-spawn ordering, cumulative envelopes, single-flight behavior, bounded terminal persistence, candidate fingerprinting, fresh proof roots, exact-fingerprint final acceptance, and objective-triggered critique disclosure. Those mechanisms matched the converged architecture. One reachable freeze blocker remained: a crash-stale RunLedger lock was never inspected or recovered, permanently preventing reservation, completion, closure, or supersession. Four bounded implementation corrections were also required before the next review.
blocking_concerns: RunLedger used a bare exclusive-create lock file and unconditionally rejected FileExistsError. A dead or unreadable holder therefore bricked every mutation of the affected run, including Owner cancellation and supersession, despite the lock payload already carrying exact process identity.
gaps: RunLedger.close was implemented but had no CLI path or regression, leaving terminal run states unreachable through the documented controller.
ProofStore omitted scope from its key, so a later intermediate record could overwrite a full_required_suite record for the same fingerprint, command, and environment.
pre_mutation_critique was absent on return_to_owner failures, making the result shape non-uniform even though the path remained fail-closed.
The controller emits critique gate evidence but does not launch workers; the separate runner or pilot must enforce that gate before mutation.
Proof-root tar extraction did not select an explicit filter on interpreters that support the filter parameter.
risks: Invocation terminal and expiry writes do not share the RunLedger record-lock discipline, leaving a narrow low-reachability lost-update risk.
Invocation terminal writes do not bind the caller to the process identity that created the lease.
Repository fingerprints read each tracked file fully rather than streaming large files.
Objective-property classification remains caller-supplied judgment and default envelopes remain uncalibrated.
All orchestration evidence stores remain user-writable, identifying evidence rather than attestation.
required_changes: Recover crash-stale, mismatched, unreadable, or expired ledger locks while continuing to refuse a genuinely live holder, with regression coverage across reserve, complete, close, and supersession.
Expose RunLedger.close through a tested close-run CLI path or remove it.
Include proof scope in the record key or otherwise prevent an intermediate record from destroying final-suite evidence.
